tools.name: plex_search
tools.description: Search across all Plex libraries for movies, TV shows, artists, or albums. Use for questions like 'do I have Inception on Plex' or 'find Star Wars on my server'.

type.description: Filter by library type (default: all). Use 'movie' to exclude TV episodes.

tools.name: plex_recently_added
tools.description: Show recently added media on the Plex server. Use for questions like 'what's new on Plex' or 'what was recently added'.

count.description: Number of items to show (default: 10, max: 50)

tools.name: plex_libraries
tools.description: List all media libraries on the Plex server. Use when the user asks about their Plex server setup.

tools.name: plex_now_playing
tools.description: Show what's currently playing on the Plex server — who is watching what, and their progress. Use for questions like 'what's playing on Plex right now' or 'who is watching Plex'.
